client_need: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control
stem: A client who self-injects insulin at home is learning how to dispose of used needles. Which statement by the client shows correct understanding?

options.A: I will place used needles immediately in an FDA-cleared sharps container when possible; if one is unavailable, an appropriate heavy-duty plastic household container may be used, and I will follow local disposal rules.
options.B: I can place loose needles in the household trash as long as I wrap each needle in tissue first.
options.C: I should flush used needles down the toilet so no one in the home can reach them.
options.D: I should put loose needles in the recycling bin because metal sharps can be separated during recycling.

rationale: A is correct. FDA recommends placing used needles and other sharps immediately into an FDA-cleared sharps disposal container when possible. If an FDA-cleared container is unavailable, an appropriate heavy-duty plastic household container with required safety features may be used as an alternative, and final disposal must follow community guidelines. Loose sharps should not be placed in household/public trash or recycling and should never be flushed down the toilet. B, C, and D therefore create preventable needlestick and infection risks.
educational_objective: Teach home injection users to place sharps immediately in an appropriate puncture-resistant disposal container and follow local requirements for final disposal rather than discarding loose needles in trash, recycling, or toilets.
source_document_title: DOs and DON'Ts of Proper Sharps Disposal; Sharps Disposal Containers; Best Way to Get Rid of Used Needles and Other Sharps
source_locator: FDA sharps disposal guidance — immediately place used sharps in a disposal container; use an FDA-cleared container if possible; if unavailable, an appropriate heavy-duty plastic household container may be used; follow community guidelines for final disposal; never place loose sharps in trash/recycling or flush them down the toilet
